suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)

# Table 1 datalines

```{R}
Table1 <- matrix(c(
  "Place of Birth: UTH % (n)", 2, 9, 5, 10,
  "Place of Birth: Chawama Clinic % (n)", 7, 9, 5, 10,
  "Male Sex", 7, 9, 5, 10,
  "BCG % (n)", 4, 9, 6, 10,
  "OPV % (n)", 4, 9, 3, 10,
  "Married % (n)", 9, 9, 9, 10,
  "Mother HIV Positive % (n)", 3, 9, 1, 3,
  "Mother on ART % (n)", 0, 3, 3, 3,
  "Mother on ART Prior to Pregnancy % (n)", 0, 0, 1, 3,
  "Third Trimester % (n)", 0, 0, 2, 2
), byrow = TRUE, ncol = 5,
dimnames = list(c(), c("Comp", "yes1", "total1", "yes2", "total2")))
```

# Function for Chi-square
Univariate inter-group analyses
Present P-value as a column in Table 1

```{R}
perform_fisher_test <- function(row) {
  print(row)
  success1 <- row[1]
  total1 <- row[2]
  success2 <- row[3]
  total2 <- row[4]
  # Create contingency table
  observed <- matrix(c(success1, total1 - success1, success2, total2 - success2), 
                     nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
  
  # Perform Fisher's exact test (useful for small sample sizes)
  fisher_test <- fisher.test(observed)
  
  return(fisher_test$p.value)
}

# Example usage:
all_ps <- as.data.frame(apply(Table1[, -1] , 2, as.numeric)) |>
  apply(1, perform_fisher_test)

Table1 |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  mutate(p = all_ps,
         adj_p = p.adjust(all_ps, method = "fdr"))
```
